vb_textbox.text: Start off testing out the number of mushrooms you get from the short gnomes and the number you get for the tall gnomes. Test these out a few times and see if the taller or shorter ones give more mushrooms. If it is the shorter ones, then keep selecting the short gnomes until they start giving much smaller numbers of mushrooms like 0, 1 or 2. Then switch to the tall gnomes and see if they start giving you more mushrooms. If they do, keep selecting the tall gnomes until they start giving less mushrooms. Then switch back to the short gnomes. Keep switching when you notice they start giving few or 0 mushrooms
